simple-mcp._info: 69 tools. Wrapper runs source mode by default (native simple_mcp_server core-dumps on tools/call; set SIMPLE_MCP_PREFER_NATIVE=1 to opt in once fixed).

simple-lsp-mcp._info: LSP MCP tools. Wrapper runs source mode by default (native fails all tools/call; lsp_diagnostics gated off in source mode, 10/11 tools work). Set SIMPLE_LSP_MCP_PREFER_NATIVE=1 to opt in once fixed.

t32-mcp._info: TRACE32 runtime MCP tools for live session control (35 tools). Aligned with the root .mcp.json entry, which is the one Claude Code actually loads; this file had fallen out of sync with it and previously omitted t32-mcp/t32-lsp-mcp/spipe entirely, so running config/mcp/install.shs on Linux/macOS would silently drop them from .mcp.json.

t32-lsp-mcp._info: TRACE32 CMM analysis MCP tools for parse, diagnostics, completions, hover, symbols, definition, and validation. Aligned with the root .mcp.json entry; see t32-mcp above for why this file needed updating.

spipe._info: SPipe MCP — process/expert surfaces for the executable SSpec workflow. Points at the .spipe/spipe submodule's pure-Simple stage-1 server, matching the root .mcp.json entry (not the retired Node/stitch server).
